prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished website hero banner, exact wide 2:1 composition, 2048 x 1024.
Create a premium editorial physical illustration for NetPlane, a self-hosted Headscale control-plane plugin for Hermes. A beautifully crafted miniature network model sits on a warm ivory drafting surface: one charcoal metal control cabinet at the center-right, a small set of porcelain device blocks arranged around it, fine copper and muted teal cables connecting them in a precise organized topology. A pale translucent architectural plane beneath the cabinet suggests the coordination layer. Tiny tactile switches and connectors, refined material detail, believable geometry and contact shadows, substantial objects rather than floating UI. The design communicates a network the operator can understand and manage. No real hostnames, IPs, credentials or personal data.
Composition: generous clean space in the left third for the exact word “NetPlane” in large restrained dark editorial typography, with the physical network model occupying the remaining space. Keep generous margins and a calm hierarchy.
Lighting: soft side-lit studio daylight, subtle paper grain, matte powder-coated metal, copper highlights. Palette: warm ivory, graphite, mineral teal and small copper accents.
Text verbatim: “NetPlane”. No other text.
Avoid: fake product screenshots, app windows, charts, security shields, padlocks, cyberpunk neon, glowing grids, logos of third parties, claims of official endorsement, watermarks. Finished art should feel like an elegant technology magazine cover with an unusually concrete physical model.
